content: आवर्तः .²1 Turning round, winding, revolving; प्रदक्षिणावर्तशिखः <ls>Rām. 6. 73. 23</ls>. .²2 A whirlpool, an eddy, whirl; नृपं तमावर्तमनोज्ञनाभिः <ls>R. 6. 52</ls>; दर्शितावर्तनाभेः <ls>Me. 28</ls>; <ls>Dk. 2</ls>; आवर्तः संशयानाम् <ls>Pt. 1. 191</ls>. .²3 Deliberation, revolving (in the mind), anxiety. .²4 A lock of hair curling backwards, especially on a horse (considered lucky); आवर्ता यस्य जायन्ते धन्यः स तुरगोत्तमः (शालिहोत्र of भोज). .²5 The two depressions of the forehead above the eye-brows. .²6 A crowded place (where many men live closely together). .²7 A kind of jewel. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of a form of cloud personified; आवर्तो निर्जलो मेघः. .²9 Melting (of metals). .²10 Doubt; भ्रमं संमोहमावर्तमभ्यासाद्विनिवर्तयेत् <ls>Mb. 12. 274. 7</ls>. .²11 Worldly existence (संसार). .{@-र्तम्@} A mineral substance, pyrites (माक्षिकधातु).
